title: `EditorHelp` width resizing performance issues
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.8.dev3
- v4.7.1.stable

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev3 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4080 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9186) - AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D 8-Core Processor (16 threads) - 63.11 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When displaying large class in `EditorHelp` and the window is large there are notable stutters when resizing to a very small or large width. When resizing to a large width, as soon as the text stops growing there is a large jump in the frame time graph. Looks like the changing margins on the side somehow make the rendering a lot more expensive than reformatting the text itself. When resizing to a very small width a smaller jump in the frame time can be seen.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a7126666-8920-4769-bd1d-818cb57a1c27

The issue is the margins are changed by adjusting styleboxes of the `RichTextLabel` `class_desc->add_theme_style_override(CoreStringName(normal), class_desc_stylebox);`. `RichTextLabel` invalidates the font cache on theme change causing a expensive recalculation when the text is drawn

### Steps to reproduce

(May need a large monitor, otherwise maybe reproducible by reducing the editor or OS scale)
- Open a large class documentation (`Node` for example)
- Make Godot and the script editor as large as possible and then resize the width of the documentation
